To: Yael Thomas, Policy Director, CFES
From: Serena Grant
Sent: March 3, 2:09 P.M.
Subject: Interest in energy regulation policy
Dear Ms. Thomas,
I attended your guest lecture yesterday on regulatory frameworks for the oil and gas sector and found your analysis of industry challenges both candid and thought-provoking. As a junior majoring in political science, I’m eager to understand how regulation affects energy markets. Could we schedule a brief call next week to discuss your experience advising state commissions on drilling permits? I especially appreciated your comments yesterday on the debate over domestic energy independence and the role of alternative fuels in shaping future infrastructure. I’m available Monday or Wednesday afternoons but can adjust to your schedule if needed.
Thank you for considering my request—I value your expertise in navigating complex policy arenas.
Best regards,
Serena Grant

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.A: To confirm attendance at alecture for academic credit
options.B: To apply for a research assistant position at a policy institute
options.C: To request a letter of recommendation for a job in the energy sector
options.D: To arrange a conversation about an expert's professional experience

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the email? 原文依据：Could we schedule a brief call next week to discuss your experience advising state commissions on drilling permits? 翻译：写信人希望预约一通简短通话，交流对方的专业工作经历。 选项分析： (A) To confirm attendance at a lecture for academic credit 确认听课学分出勤 → 错误，邮件无学分、出勤确认相关内容 (B) To apply for a research assistant position at a policy institute 申请政策研究所助研岗位 → 错误，全文无求职、申请岗位表述 (C) To request a letter of recommendation for a job in the energy sector 索要能源行业求职推荐信 → 错误，未提及推荐信需求 (D) To arrange a conversation about an expert's professional experience 预约交流专家的职业工作经历 → 正确，贴合邮件核心诉求

questions.stem: What aspect of energy regulation is Serena interested in?

options.A: Its ability to solve the energy industry's problems
options.D: Its effects on building new energy infrastructure

questions.analysis: What aspect of energy regulation is Serena interested in? 原文依据：I’m eager to understand how regulation affects energy markets. 翻译：我迫切想要了解监管政策会对能源市场产生怎样的影响。 选项分析： (A) Its ability to solve the energy industry's problems 解决能源行业难题的能力 → 错误，只是夸赞讲座分析行业挑战，并非核心关注方向 (B) Its relation to markets 与能源市场的关联 → 正确，对应原文 regulation affects energy markets (C) Its critique of traditional fuels 对传统燃料的批判 → 错误，文中仅提及替代能源，无批判传统燃料内容 (D) Its effects on building new energy infrastructure 对新建能源基建的影响 → 错误，只是讲座提及内容，并非本人核心兴趣点

questions.stem: What will Serena probably do if Ms.Thomas offers to call her on a Tuesday morning?

options.A: Remind her that she is free on Monday and Wednesday afternoons
options.B: Suggest that they have the call on the weekend instead
options.C: Change her own schedule and agree to a call on Tuesday
options.D: Suggest that they compromise and speak on a Monday or Wednesday morning

questions.analysis: What will Serena probably do if Ms.Thomas offers to call her on a Tuesday morning? 原文依据：I’m available Monday or Wednesday afternoons but can adjust to your schedule if needed. 翻译：我周一、周三下午有空，如有需要，也可以配合调整时间。 选项分析： (A) Remind her that she is free on Monday and Wednesday afternoons 只提醒自己原有空闲时间 → 错误，原文表明可灵活调整 (B) Suggest that they have the call on the weekend instead 提议改到周末通话 → 错误，文中未提及周末可行 (C) Change her own schedule and agree to a call on Tuesday 调整个人时间、同意周二通话 → 正确，adjust to your schedule 说明可配合对方时间 (D) Suggest that they compromise and speak on a Monday or Wednesday morning 协商改至周一 / 周三上午 → 错误，无协商调换时段的表述
